dimensions.assessment: Affects covered veterans and caregivers across the country who receive VA care.
dimensions.evidence: to any covered veteran or caregiver of a covered veteran at no charge and without a prescription

dimensions.assessment: Potentially life-saving effect for individuals at risk of opioid overdose.
Provides medications at no charge at VA pharmacies, requiring ongoing VA funding and resource allocation.
dimensions.evidence: at no charge and without a prescription

dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall make covered medications available at pharmacies

dimensions.assessment: Establishes an ongoing distribution requirement with recurring annual reporting to Congress.
dimensions.evidence: annually thereafter, the Secretary shall submit to Congress a report
